decisions.reason: A glazed industrial sectional door builds directly on the firm's core sectional-door and metal-fabrication knowledge, so the firm can read market feedback and improve it in-house, which favours keeping it.

The insulated glazed variant combines the firm's established thermal and sectional-door expertise and meets growing energy-efficiency requirements, making it a natural extension the firm can develop further.
Presented on a dedicated page, this glazed industrial door sits at the heart of the firm's industrial-door competence and appears to be a showcased product, so dropping it is unlikely.
